quests.name: Invite the Guests
quests.notes: MVP objective: buying minions progresses the quest.

quests.name: Burn the Evidence
quests.notes: Deleted/history-only objective: selling minions no longer appears in the normal Quest pool; sell events remain available for rewards.

quests.name: Track the Footprints
quests.notes: MVP objective: successful manual Tavern refreshes progress the quest.

quests.name: Follow the Money
quests.notes: MVP objective: Gold spent on buying, rolling, upgrading, and mechanics progresses the quest.

quests.name: Cry for Help
quests.notes: MVP objective: playing minions with the Battlecry keyword progresses the quest.

quests.name: Dust for Prints
quests.notes: Tracks cards added to hand, including buys and generated cards.

rewards.name: Cooked Book
rewards.text: After you buy a minion, give it +2/+2 and improve this.
rewards.notes: MVP reward: buffs bought minions in hand and improves by +1/+1 after each trigger.

rewards.name: Hidden Treasure Vault
rewards.text: At the start of each turn, gain 1 Gold. (Improves each turn!)
rewards.notes: MVP reward: grants Gold at turn start and increases its future Gold amount by 1.

rewards.name: Mirror Shield
rewards.text: After the Tavern is Refreshed, give a random minion in it +6/+6 and Divine Shield.
rewards.notes: Buffs one random Tavern minion on successful refresh and grants Divine Shield.

rewards.name: Tiny Henchmen
rewards.text: At the end of your turn, give +3/+3 to 3 friendly minions of Tier 3 or lower.
rewards.notes: MVP reward: buffs up to three friendly Tier 3 or lower minions at end of turn.

rewards.name: Untold Riches
rewards.text: Get a 5-Gold Coin Pouch. Increase your maximum Gold by 5.
rewards.notes: MVP reward: grants Gold immediately and raises maximum Gold.

rewards.name: Theotar's Parasol
rewards.text: At the end of your turn, give your right-most minion Stealth until next turn and +8 Health.
rewards.notes: Hidden-effect-only reward. Removes its temporary Stealth at the next friendly turn start.

rewards.name: Exquisite Conch
rewards.text: Your first Battlecry each turn triggers 2 extra times.
rewards.notes: Resolved in MatchService.GetBattlecryRepeats; first Battlecry each turn gets +2 repeats.

rewards.name: The Smoking Gun
rewards.text: Your minions have +4 Attack.
rewards.notes: Applies current-board buff on completion and combat aura for battle clones and summons.

rewards.name: Red Hand
rewards.text: At the start of each turn, give a minion in your hand +12/+12.
rewards.notes: Randomly buffs one hand minion at the start of each friendly turn.

rewards.name: Staff of Origination
rewards.text: Start of Combat: Give your minions +12/+12.
rewards.notes: Prepared before combat through TavernState.NextCombatBoardAttack/Health.

rewards.name: Alter Ego
rewards.text: Even-Tier minions in the Tavern have +7/+7. (Swaps to Odd next turn!)
rewards.notes: Applies alternating even/odd shop buffs at turn start.

rewards.name: Menagerie Mayhem
rewards.text: At the end of your turn, give your minions +1/+1 for each different friendly minion type.
rewards.notes: Counts distinct friendly minion types and buffs the board by that amount.

rewards.name: Volatile Venom
rewards.text: Your minions have +7/+7. After they attack, they die. Horribly.
rewards.notes: CombatEngine applies the combat aura and kills friendly attackers after their attack resolves.

rewards.name: Blood Goblet
rewards.text: At the end of your turn, give your right-most minion Attack equal to your missing Health.
rewards.notes: Uses player MaxHealth minus current Health; armor is not counted as missing Health.

rewards.name: Sinfall Medallion
rewards.text: After you play a minion, give 2 other friendly minions of its Tier +4/+4.
rewards.notes: Buffs up to two other friendly minions with the played minion's Tavern Tier.

rewards.name: Enhance-a-matic
rewards.text: At the start of each turn, get an Enhanced Part that gives +5/+5 and a random bonus.
rewards.notes: Generates one of BG24_Reward_715t through BG24_Reward_715t4.

rewards.name: Boom Squad
rewards.text: Avenge (3): Deal 10 damage to the highest-Health enemy minion.
rewards.notes: CombatEngine tracks Avenge (3) and damages the highest-Health enemy minion.

rewards.name: Sturdy Shard
rewards.text: At the end of your turn, give your minions without Taunt +1/+2 for each friendly Taunt minion.
rewards.notes: Counts friendly Taunt minions and buffs non-Taunt friendly minions.

rewards.name: Map of the Unknown
rewards.text: After you play a minion of a type you don't control, give a friendly minion of each type +2/+2.
rewards.notes: Triggers when the played minion introduces at least one currently unique friendly type.

rewards.name: Endless Blood Moon
rewards.text: Your Blood Gems give an extra +1/+1. At the start of each turn, get two Blood Gems.
rewards.notes: Improves Blood Gems on completion; turn-start gem generation is handled as a continuous active reward.

rewards.name: Tumbling Disaster
rewards.text: Whenever you summon a minion in combat, give it +4/+4. Avenge (4): Improve this permanently.
rewards.notes: CombatEngine buffs combat summons and improves the stored buff by +1/+1 per Avenge (4); official increment needs live verification.

rewards.name: Righteous Charge
rewards.text: Start of Combat: Your left-most minion gains Divine Shield and attacks immediately.
rewards.notes: Prepared before combat using the existing immediate attack pending tag.

rewards.name: Grim Freshener
rewards.text: Avenge (2): Gain a free Refresh.
rewards.notes: CombatEngine tracks Avenge (2) and queues free Refresh rewards.

rewards.name: Rushing Winds
rewards.text: Spellcraft: Give a minion Windfury and Divine Shield.
rewards.notes: Generates BG33_Reward_006t at the start of each friendly turn.

rewards.name: 8-Gold Coin Pouch
rewards.text: Gain 8 Gold when this Quest is completed.
rewards.notes: Local Shady Aristocrat reward with no official dbfId. Rule follows text: gain 8 Gold when the Quest is completed.

rewards.name: 16-Gold Coin Pouch
rewards.text: Gain 16 Gold when this Quest is completed.
rewards.notes: Local Golden Shady Aristocrat reward with no official dbfId. Rule follows text: gain 16 Gold when the Quest is completed.

rewards.name: Snicker Snacks
rewards.text: At the end of your turn, 2 friendly minions trigger their Battlecries.
rewards.notes: At turn end, randomly chooses up to two friendly Battlecry minions and replays their Battlecry through the existing Battlecry resolver.

rewards.name: Victim's Specter
rewards.text: After each combat, get a plain copy of the last friendly minion that died.
rewards.notes: Uses combat death history to find the last Player-owned dead minion, then adds a plain base copy to hand if there is room.

rewards.name: Teal Tiger Sapphire
rewards.text: Minions in the Tavern have +1/+1 for each time it was Refreshed this turn.
rewards.notes: Counts successful manual/free refreshes this turn. Tavern minions receive only the missing delta, so frozen minions do not over-stack. Tavern-zone bonus resets at next turn start.

rewards.name: Devils in the Details
rewards.text: At the end of your turn, your left and right-most minions consume a minion in the Tavern to gain its stats.
rewards.notes: At turn end, the left-most and right-most friendly minions each consume one random Tavern minion if available. A single friendly minion consumes only once.

rewards.name: Gift of the Golden Kobold
rewards.text: After you Refresh 5 times, make the highest-Tier minion in the Tavern Golden.
rewards.notes: Counts successful manual/free refreshes. Every fifth refresh makes the left-most highest-Tier non-Golden Tavern minion Golden, then resets the counter.

rewards.name: Stolen Gold
rewards.text: Start of Combat: Make your left and right-most minions Golden.
rewards.notes: At combat start, only the combat copies of the left-most and right-most friendly minions are made Golden. A single minion is processed once.

rewards.name: Evil Twin
rewards.text: Start of Combat: Summon a copy of your highest-Health minion.
rewards.notes: At combat start, appends a combat-only copy of the highest-current-Health friendly minion if board space exists. Ties use the left-most minion.

rewards.name: Ritual Dagger
rewards.text: After a friendly Deathrattle minion dies, give it +5/+5 permanently.
rewards.notes: Combat rewards identify friendly Deathrattle minions that died; if the original Tavern board minion still exists, it gains permanent +5/+5.

rewards.name: Cycle of Energy
rewards.text: Avenge (3): Get a random Tavern spell.
rewards.notes: CombatEngine tracks Avenge (3). Each trigger queues one random Tavern spell reward, added to hand after combat if there is room.

rewards.name: Stable Amalgamation
rewards.text: Avenge (7): When you have space, summon a 50/50 Amalgam.
rewards.notes: CombatEngine tracks Avenge (7) and summons a 50/50 all-type Amalgam in combat when a board slot is available.

rewards.name: Turbulent Tombs
rewards.text: Get a copy of '0'. Your Deathrattles trigger an extra time.
rewards.notes: The official child copy is unresolved, so this stays DebugOnly. The global extra Deathrattle trigger is implemented in combat.

rewards.name: Anima Bribe
rewards.text: After you sell a minion, give its stats to a minion in the Tavern.
rewards.notes: After selling a friendly minion, buffs a random Tavern minion by the sold minion current Attack/Health.

rewards.name: Invigorating Conch
rewards.text: When you buy a minion, give its stats to a random friendly minion.
rewards.notes: Buying a minion gives its current Attack/Health to one random friendly board minion.

rewards.name: Double-Headed Reward
rewards.text: The first time you buy a card each turn, get an extra copy of it.
rewards.notes: Once per turn, the first bought card creates a copy in hand if hand space is available.

rewards.name: Stash of the Scribe
rewards.text: At the start of each turn, get 3 random Tavern spells.
rewards.notes: At turn start, adds up to three random available Tavern spells from the current Tavern tier or lower.

rewards.name: Beyond the Mirage
rewards.text: Tavern spells cost (1) less.
rewards.notes: Continuous passive checked by the buy-cost helper; Tavern spells cost 1 less, minimum 0.

rewards.name: Bloodsoaked Tome
rewards.text: Minions in the Tavern cost 2 Gold.
rewards.notes: Continuous passive checked by the buy-cost helper; Tavern minions cost 2 Gold.

rewards.name: Splitting Scroll
rewards.text: Whenever you buy a Tavern spell that costs (3) or more, get an extra copy of it.
rewards.notes: Uses the actual paid purchase cost stored on the bought Tavern spell; cost >= 3 copies it to hand.

rewards.name: Golden Forge
rewards.text: At the start of each turn, make the highest-Tier minion in the Tavern Golden.
rewards.notes: At turn start, makes the left-most highest-Tier non-Golden Tavern minion Golden.

rewards.name: Secret Sinstone
rewards.text: After you Discover a card, get an extra copy of it.
rewards.notes: After a Discover card is added to hand, adds one cloned hand-eligible copy if hand space remains.

rewards.name: Doppelganger's Locket
rewards.text: After each combat, Discover a non-Golden minion from your last opponent's warband. It keeps enchantments.
rewards.notes: Starts a Discover from the last opponent combat-board snapshot, filtering Golden minions and preserving enchantments on the offered copies.

rewards.name: Partner in Crime
rewards.text: Get your Golden Buddy.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly per implementation plan. On completion, adds the selected hero's Golden Buddy to hand if a buddy mapping exists.

rewards.name: Open Auditions
rewards.text: At the start of each turn, Discover a Buddy.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly per implementation plan. Starts a three-option Buddy Discover at turn start and does not overwrite an existing Discover.

rewards.name: Quaint Boutique
rewards.text: At the start of your next turn, gain 4 Gold and choose a Lesser Trinket to buy.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly per implementation plan. Schedules a next-turn Lesser Trinket choice and grants 4 Gold before the choice is offered.

rewards.name: Jumbo Warehouse
rewards.text: At the start of your next turn, gain 4 Gold and choose a Greater Trinket to buy.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly per implementation plan. Schedules a next-turn Greater Trinket choice and grants 4 Gold before the choice is offered.

rewards.name: Cosmic Reward
rewards.text: Discover a second Hero Power.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly per implementation plan. Stores the chosen Hero Power in ExtraHeroPowerCardIds; UI and use-selection can be expanded later.

rewards.name: Ghastly Mask
rewards.text: Your end-of-turn effects trigger an extra time.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly because the official child copy is unresolved. Proxy repeats friendly minion end-of-turn handlers once.

rewards.name: The Friends Along the Way
rewards.text: At the start of your turn, get 2 random placeholder-92 cards.
rewards.notes: Disabled because official placeholder-92 content is unresolved. Direct activation uses random current-tier minions as a safe proxy.

rewards.name: Yogg-tastic Tasties
rewards.text: At the start of your turn, spin the Wheel of Yogg-Saron.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Proxy wheel resolves one deterministic random economy, buff, refresh, spell, or minion outcome.

rewards.name: Another Hidden Body
rewards.text: Discover a minion from your Tavern Tier.
rewards.notes: Offerable. No official dbfId is reconciled locally; rule follows text by starting the existing current-Tavern-Tier minion Discover flow.

rewards.name: Wondrous Wisdomball
rewards.text: Occasionally gives your Tavern helpful refreshes.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Proxy applies one Knockoff Wisdomball-style helpful refresh every 3 refreshes.

rewards.name: Pilfered Lamps
rewards.text: You only need 2 copies of a minion to make it Golden.
rewards.notes: Offerable. No official dbfId is reconciled locally; rule follows text by changing the player triple threshold from 3 copies to 2 copies.

rewards.name: Essence of Zerus
rewards.text: At the end of your turn, get a Shifter Zerus that transforms each turn.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Adds a proxy Zerus card; cards tagged from it transform into random available minions at turn start.

rewards.name: Ethereal Evidence
rewards.text: At the start of your turn, choose from 2 new Rewards.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Offers two normal-pool rewards as an immediate Bonus reward choice each turn.

rewards.name: Kidnap Sack
rewards.text: Spellcraft: Choose a non-Golden card in the Tavern and move it to your hand.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Current command model has no shop-target selector, so the proxy moves the first non-Golden Tavern card.

rewards.name: The Golden Hammer
rewards.text: Spellcraft: Make a friendly minion Golden until next turn.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Generated spell targets a friendly board minion and reverts the temporary Golden stats next turn.

rewards.name: Timeline Acceleration
rewards.text: At the start of your turn, get 2 spells that transform a minion into one from a Tavern Tier higher.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Generated spells target a friendly minion and replace it with a random available minion one Tavern Tier higher.

rewards.name: Gilnean War Horn
rewards.text: Your Battlecries trigger an extra time.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly because the official child copy is unresolved. Active reward adds +1 to Battlecry repeat count.

rewards.name: Scepter of Guidance
rewards.text: Whenever the Tavern is refreshed, it always offers 2 placeholder-92 cards.
rewards.notes: Disabled because official placeholder-92 content is unresolved. Direct activation fills two Tavern slots with safe random minion proxies.

rewards.name: Temporal Tampering
rewards.text: Your Tavern spells cast an extra time.
rewards.notes: Offerable. No official dbfId is reconciled locally; rule follows text by contributing +1 to the existing Tavern spell extra-cast path.

rewards.name: Smelting Chamber
rewards.text: At the start of your turn, make a friendly Tier 1 minion Golden, then improve this.
rewards.notes: Offerable. No official dbfId is reconciled locally; rule follows text by making one friendly minion of the tracked tier Golden, then increasing the tracked tier.

rewards.name: Secret Culprit
rewards.text: Get a copy of a random Tier 7 minion.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly because the exact official child card is unresolved. Direct activation adds a random available Tier 7 minion or highest-tier fallback.

rewards.name: Untamed Sorcery
rewards.text: At the start of your turn, cast 5 random Tavern spells.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Proxy casts random available Tavern spells with automatic friendly target fallback where possible.

rewards.name: Norgannon's Reward
rewards.text: Unlock Tavern Tier 7. At the start of your next turn, upgrade your Tavern once.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Max Tavern Tier is already 7; reward schedules one no-cost automatic upgrade on the next turn.

rewards.name: Magicfin Relic
rewards.text: At the start of your turn, get a 1/1 Murloc and Discover a Tavern spell to teach it.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Proxy summons a 1/1 Murloc if there is board space and starts a Tavern spell Discover that casts onto it.

rewards.name: Perpetual Incantation
rewards.text: Your Tavern spells have +2/+1. This improves forever.
rewards.notes: Offerable. No official dbfId is reconciled locally; rule follows text by adding scaling TavernSpellBonusAttack/Health to Tavern spells and increasing after each Tavern spell cast.

rewards.name: Rallying Cry
rewards.text: Your Rally effects trigger an extra time.
rewards.notes: DebugOnly. Active reward sets QuestRallyExtraTriggers and CombatEngine adds one extra Rally trigger.
